title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew made with tender beef and potatoes, served with a side of crusty bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, beef broth, and red wine, and bring to a boil.
Return the beef to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
